Opening the VLP Maths Tools…

VLP Maths Tools PRIMARYVersion 20.8 · 26 November 2026

Settings

Saved in this browser. A school can set these once and share them with Save a copy for your school (under Branding).

Year overviewSave, load, print or check your changes

Save or load

All three tabs share one year overview. Save it to a file to keep a copy, move it to another computer, or give your team the same program. Loading a file changes the year overview in all three tabs for the levels in the file.

Print on A3

One A3 landscape page. Choose Save as PDF in the print window for a PDF.

Your changes

BrandingYour school's name, logo and colours

Your school's name, logo and colours on these tools, and in the page header of the Maths Repository's Word planners and the Quadrant Check's Word sheets. Daily Review slides stay as they are.

Colours

Your own colours: the main colour needs to be dark enough for white writing.
VLP Maths Tools Accent

Logo

No logo

PNG, JPG or SVG. It shows at the top left, beside the tool's name.

It shows beside the logo at the top of the tools, and in the page header of the Maths Repository's Word planners and the Quadrant Check's Word sheets.

Share it with your staff

Save a copy for your school downloads a copy of this file with your school name, colours, logo, format and data settings built in. Share that copy with your teachers, and it opens with them on every computer.

FormatBlocked

How your school sets out maths across the week. It changes the year overview in all three tabs.

Your blocked and 3 + 2 year overviews are kept separately, so switching back and forth loses nothing.

DataOff

Where the traffic lights on Maths Repository lessons come from. Choose one.

Switching keeps both sets of results: PAT uploads and marked checks stay in this browser and come back if you switch again.

Your SharePoint folderSave straight into your school's SharePoint, and pick up the VLP files

Connect the Teaching and Learning folder in your OneDrive (the shortcut to your school's SharePoint site). The planners, lesson slides, Daily Review slides and Quadrant Checks you make are then saved into the folder of the sequence they belong to, the A3 lesson summary can be kept up to date when you change a lesson, and the tools pick up the VLP files and school edits from Whole School › VLP Resources by themselves. If this computer blocks folders, files download as before.

Lesson slides

The VLP lesson slides come in a separate file for each level. Add the levels you teach once, and the Maths Repository's Also download the lesson slides works for them on this computer.

Paste the link to the folder on your school drive (SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive or Teams). When a level's slides aren't added yet, the Maths Repository shows Open our school's slides folder with this link. Save a copy for your school (under Branding) builds it in for every teacher. A drive letter or network path (such as S:\Maths) is shown with a Copy button instead, because a browser can't open those from a link.

Levels on this computer

Choose one or more, for example VLP Maths Slides - Level 1.zip

From your school folder

Put the slides files in Teaching and Learning › Whole School › VLP Resources › Lesson slides, once for the whole school. Every teacher who connects the Teaching and Learning folder (Settings › SharePoint folder) then gets them, read from the folder, with nothing to add on each computer.

Or use a slides folder (Chrome and Edge)

Point the tool at the folder where your school keeps the slides files, such as the shared drive. Every level in it is added, and new or updated levels in the folder are picked up. Your browser may ask now and then to allow access.

Keyboard shortcuts

  • 1 2 3 Maths Repository, Quadrant Check, Daily Review
  • Ctrl + Z Undo the last change to the year overview
  • Ctrl + P Print this tab (buttons and panels are left off)
  • S Save results, while marking a Quadrant Check
  • ? This list

Shortcuts don't apply while you're typing in a box.
Opening…

    Setting this up for your school?

    In Settings, add your school's name, logo and colours, choose Blocked or 3 + 2, and choose where class results come from (PAT Maths or Quadrant Check). Then Save a copy for your school and share that copy with staff: it opens set up the same way for everyone.
